shellCommands.command: cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/SKILL.md && echo ---- && find .agents -type f && echo ---- && ls -la && cat AGENTS.md | head -100 && cat package.json 2>/dev/null

cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md | head -80 && echo ---- && cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md && echo ---- && find src -type f | xargs -I{} sh -c 'echo "== {}"; cat {}' && echo ---- && cat index.html vite.config.ts tsconfig.json .gitignore && ls __agent_eval__ && node -p "require('@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json').version" && ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs 2>/dev/null | head

grep -n -i "page-constructor" .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md | head -20; echo ----; grep -n -A30 "^## Page" .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md | head -60; echo ----; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/; echo ----; grep '"version"' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs 2>/dev/null; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/ ; echo ----; cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh | head -40

npm view @gravity-ui/page-constructor version peerDependencies dependencies 2>&1 | head -80; echo ----; npm view @gravity-ui/page-constructor dist-tags 2>&1; echo ----; npm view @gravity-ui/uikit@7.43.0 peerDependencies 2>&1 | head -20
cd /tmp && curl -sS -m 20 -o pc8.md -w "%{http_code}\n" https://gravity-ui.com/llms/page-constructor/8/llms.txt; wc -c pc8.md 2>/dev/null; head -c 3000 pc8.md 2>/dev/null
cd /tmp && sed -n '1,400p' pc8.md | tail -c 14700

npm view @diplodoc/transform@^4.28.2 version 2>/dev/null | tail -1; npm view sass version 2>/dev/null | tail -1; npm view vite-plugin-dynamic-import version 2>/dev/null | tail -1; npm install --save @gravity-ui/page-constructor@^8.24.1 @diplodoc/transform@^4.28.2 2>&1 | tail -15

npm install --save-dev sass 2>&1 | tail -3; for p in page-constructor uikit icons i18n; do node -e 'const p=require(process.argv[1]+"/package.json"); console.log(p.name, p.version)' ./node_modules/@gravity-ui/$p 2>/dev/null || true; done; grep -E '"(version)"' node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/package.json node_modules/@diplodoc/transform/package.json; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/docs 2>/dev/null | head; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/docs/blocks 2>/dev/null | head -50; cat package.json

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor && cat build/docs/INDEX.md | head -60; echo ====README; grep -n -i -A12 "required setup\|## Install\|vite" README.md | head -80; echo ====HEADER; cat build/docs/blocks/Header.md | head -150

P=/home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor; sed -n '1,200p' $P/build/docs/blocks/ExtendedFeatures.md; echo ====BANNER; sed -n '1,120p' $P/build/docs/blocks/Banner.md; echo ====ANIM; grep -rn -i "animated" $P/build/docs/*.md $P/build/docs/blocks/Header.md $P/README.md 2>/dev/null | head -10
cat package.json | grep -E '"(main|types|module|exports)"' -A3 | head -30; ls build | head -30; echo ----; grep -rl "PageConstructorProvider" build --include=*.d.ts | head -5

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/esm && cat containers/PageConstructor/Provider.d.ts; echo ----; cat containers/PageConstructor/index.d.ts; echo ----; grep -n "export" index.d.ts | head -30; echo ----; grep -rn "ExtendedFeaturesItem\b" --include=*.d.ts . | head -3; grep -rln "'extended-features-block'\|\"extended-features-block\"" --include=*.d.ts . | head -3

sed -n '160,185p' models/constructor-items/blocks.d.ts; echo ----; grep -n "interface HeaderBlock\b\|interface BannerBlock\b\|interface ExtendedFeaturesBlock\|interface HeaderBlockProps\|export interface .*Block " models/constructor-items/blocks.d.ts | head; echo ----; grep -n "interface PageConstructorProps" -A8 containers/PageConstructor/PageConstructor.d.ts; echo ---; grep -rn "interface PageContent\|content: \|export type PageContent" models/*.d.ts containers/PageConstructor/PageConstructor.d.ts | head; echo; grep -n "ButtonBlock\b" -A10 models/constructor-items/common.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -20

cat models/constructor.d.ts; echo ----; sed -n '120,145p' models/constructor-items/blocks.d.ts; echo ----; grep -n "interface BannerProps\|interface BannerBlock" -A12 models/constructor-items/blocks.d.ts | head -30; echo ----; grep -rn "interface Animatable" -A3 models | head

grep -rn "~@" node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/styles/*.scss node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/esm/containers/PageConstructor/*.css 2>/dev/null | head -5; grep -rn "styles.css\|\.css'" node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/esm/containers/PageConstructor/PageConstructor.js 2>/dev/null | head -3; ls node_modules/@diplodoc/transform/dist/css/ 2>/dev/null | head; grep -n -i "~@\|alias" node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/README.md | head

grep -rhoE "from '(url|fs|path|crypto|stream|util|os|buffer|events|process|zlib|http|https|querystring)'" node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/esm | sort | uniq -c; grep -rln "from 'url'" node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/esm | head; grep -rn "parse\|format" node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/esm/utils/url.js | head
npm install --save url@^0.11.4 2>&1 | grep -v "npm warn" | tail -3; ls node_modules/url/ && grep -n '"main"\|"version"' node_modules/url/package.json

grep -rn "import(" node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/esm --include=*.js | grep -v "\.map" | head -10; echo ----; ls dist/assets | head; grep -o "Что вы получаете\|Начать работу\|Понятно, куда уходит время вашей команды" dist/assets/*.js | sort | uniq -c
rm -rf dist && npm run build >/dev/null 2>&1; echo "build exit: $?"; rm -rf dist; git diff -- package.json index.html vite.config.ts | head -80; cat src/index.css
